title: The Renewal Grace Period for Domain Registrations
content:
## Support desk guidance — the renewal grace period of Domain Registrations

**Status.** A grace-period renewal may be charged only while the domain status is grace.

**Billing (no longer in force).** The clause "A grace-period renewal is billed at the price set by the renewal charge terms, booked as a grace-period renewal, and returns the domain to active" is no longer in force — superseded by the current basis for grace-period renewals of Domain Registrations.

**Window.** A grace-period renewal is allowed only on or before the registration expiry date recorded on the domain plus the TLD's renewal grace days, counted in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the expiry date, counting the day after the expiry date as day 1, and the last day of the window is included.

**DNS while expired.** From the TLD's DNS parking start day after expiry, the domain's DNS points to the Harborline renewal notice page until the domain is renewed, and the renewal restores the previous DNS.

**After the window.** After the window closes the domain can no longer be renewed and passes to redemption, where only a redemption restore brings it back.

### How the window is read

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | the registration expiry date recorded on the domain (system record) |
| Day 1 | the day after the expiry date |
| Length | the TLD's renewal grace days, whole calendar days |
| Comparison | the renewal day is not later than the last day of the window |
| Last day | included |

### Boundary cases (abstract)

- A renewal on the last day of the window — the expiry date plus the TLD's renewal grace days — is allowed.
- A renewal on the day after that last day is not allowed under this window.
- Hypothetical: with an expiry date of 10 March 2029 and a 25-day window, day 1 is 11 March and the last day is 4 April 2029; 4 April is inside, 5 April is outside.

### Basis

Both the grace status and the expiry date are taken from the system record of the domain being renewed, not from the customer's account of when they meant to renew.

superseded_clauses: It is billed at the price set by domain_renewal_pricing, booked as charge_type grace_renewal, and returns the domain to active.
